propositions: Reconcile Bridge runs on GitHub Actions lack CloudWatch visibility; workflow failures only surface in GitHub logs and step summaries, not to monitoring systems
Jira API-token outage took the bridge down but produced zero CloudWatch alarms, exposing a blind spot in host-level observability metrics
GitHub Actions workflows can publish metrics to CloudWatch via OIDC-federated AWS credentials, but this repo has no workflow currently doing so
A new narrowly-scoped IAM role must grant only cloudwatch:PutMetricData constrained to the rebar/host namespace, avoiding permission scope creep on existing roles
Bridge failure metric must publish 0 on success and 1 on failure to make the publisher itself observable and keep alarms in OK rather than INSUFFICIENT_DATA state
CloudWatch alarm on bridge_run_failures must use period=3600 and threshold=1 to page on second failure within an hour, distinguishing transient blips from sustained outages like token expiry
